description: Close N1 and implement the owner's website-only ruling for the inbound payment path: retire the in-WhatsApp PAYMENT producer's financial side effects (Meta/WhatsApp payment-status producer in messaging/inbound-whatsapp-handler) so it can no longer create paid invoices/orders/receipts from an unverified fail-open capture, after proving no active caller still legitimately drives it. WhatsApp OTP, support, and authorized receipt/order NOTIFICATIONS stay fully intact. Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: Prove the caller map first. In amplify/functions/messaging/inbound-whatsapp-handler/handler.py, _process_payment_status is reached from _process_status_update at lines ~2949-2951 when status_type == 'payment'. Trace and document every caller/entry of the financial side effects it invokes: _mark_invoice_paid_by_reference (:3596), _generate_invoice_for_captured_payment (:3652), the CAPTURED branch's _send_order_status_message (:3545) and _check_and_notify_balance_due. Record (in findings) that these financial side effects are only reachable via the Meta in-WhatsApp payment capture — which the owner has removed from the active purchase flow — and that the ONLY authoritative payment producer going forward is the Razorpay webhook (payments/razorpay-webhook/handler.py). Confirm with grep that no other active handler depends on the in-WhatsApp capture creating paid state.

Retire the financial side effects of the CAPTURED branch (the N1 fail-open path at :3514-3557): the producer must NOT create paid invoices/orders/receipts without authoritative provider-verified capture. Since in-WhatsApp payment is removed from the active flow, redirect the CAPTURED branch so it performs NO financial state mutation: do not call _mark_invoice_paid_by_reference, do not call _generate_invoice_for_captured_payment, do not mint any paid state. Instead, log a clearly-labelled 'in_whatsapp_payment_capture_superseded' record (type-only / correlation-id only, no event body) so the event is auditable, and leave a code comment marking the branch SUPERSEDED by the owner's 2026-10-01 website-only ruling with a pointer to the Razorpay webhook as the single authoritative producer.

Keep legacy consumers safe: do NOT delete the function or the webhook routing wholesale. Preserve the ability to receive the status webhook (so delivery/read/sent status handling and any non-financial notification continue), and preserve WhatsApp OTP, support auto-replies (PAY_MSG pulling/no_dues/error etc. used elsewhere), and authorized receipt/order notifications. Only the capture-driven FINANCIAL side effects are retired/redirected.

Do NOT weaken the Razorpay webhook. The single authoritative verification boundary is razorpay_verify (payment_is_captured / verifier_for_event) used by the webhook; after this change every retained inbound payment producer either shares that boundary (the webhook) or creates no financial state (the retired Meta branch).

If any constant/flag (e.g. PAYMENT_LOOKUP_REQUIRED) becomes dead on the financial path after retirement, leave it defined with a comment rather than silently removing env-var contracts, but ensure no code path can create paid state from an unverified capture regardless of its value.

Add regression tests (new tests/test_inbound_whatsapp_payment_superseded.py, or extend an existing inbound-handler test) that drive the real _process_payment_status with a forged/unverified 'captured' payment status event and assert it creates NO paid invoice and NO receipt/order (no financial mutation on the DynamoDB fake), while a non-payment status event still processes normally. The test must fail if the retirement is reverted (i.e. if the CAPTURED branch again calls _mark_invoice_paid_by_reference).
acceptance_criteria: The Meta/WhatsApp payment-status CAPTURED branch creates zero paid invoices/orders/receipts; it performs no financial state mutation
A clearly-labelled SUPERSEDED log/audit record is emitted for in-WhatsApp capture events, type-only (no event body/secret)
WhatsApp status-webhook receipt, OTP, support auto-replies, and authorized notifications remain intact (no deletion of the status route or messaging helpers)
The Razorpay webhook remains the single authoritative payment producer sharing the razorpay_verify boundary; no weaker parallel path can create paid state
findings documents the proof that no active caller still requires the in-WhatsApp capture to create paid state
New test asserts a forged unverified capture creates no financial state and fails if the retirement is reverted; full pytest suite stays green
findings:
Closed N1 and applied the owner's 2026-10-01 website-only ruling to the inbound payment path in amplify/functions/messaging/inbound-whatsapp-handler/handler.py.

CALLER-MAP PROOF (recorded before any edit): _process_payment_status is reached ONLY from _process_status (the status webhook router) at line ~2951 when status_type == 'payment' (or 'payment' in status). The three financial side-effect functions and the CAPTURED-branch confirmation are each DEFINED and CALLED only inside this one handler's CAPTURED branch:
  grep -rn across amplify/ scripts/ for _mark_invoice_paid_by_reference -> inbound handler def (:3577) + its single CAPTURED call (now removed); plus a SEPARATE, unrelated def+call in payments/razorpay-webhook/handler.py (:1676 / :1055 - the authoritative producer, untouched).
  _generate_invoice_for_captured_payment -> inbound handler only (def + single CAPTURED call, now removed).
  _check_and_notify_balance_due -> inbound handler only (def + single CAPTURED call, now removed); the only other hit is a docstring mention in payments/invoice-engine/handler.py, not a call.
  _process_payment_status -> defined + called only in this handler.
Conclusion: the in-WhatsApp capture-driven FINANCIAL side effects were reachable ONLY via this Meta in-WhatsApp payment capture, which the owner removed from the active purchase flow. No other active handler depends on the in-WhatsApp capture creating paid state. The ONLY authoritative payment producer going forward is the Razorpay webhook (payments/razorpay-webhook/handler.py) via lambda_utils/integrations/razorpay_verify (payment_is_captured / verifier_for_event).

RETIREMENT: the CAPTURED branch's financial tail (previously reject-handling, the fail-open 'payment_capture_accepted_unverified' accept log, _mark_invoice_paid_by_reference, the 'completed' _send_order_status_message, _generate_invoice_for_captured_payment, _check_and_notify_balance_due) is replaced by a single clearly-labelled, type-only audit record: logger.error 'in_whatsapp_payment_capture_superseded' (correlation ids + verificationOutcome/lookupRequired only; NO event body, NO amount/contact/transaction id/secret). A SUPERSEDED comment block marks the branch retired by the 2026-10-01 website-only ruling and points to the Razorpay webhook as the single authoritative producer. The branch now performs NO financial state mutation and mints NO paid invoice/order/receipt. The raw payment record (_store_payment_record) is still written for audit (non-financial).

LEGACY CONSUMERS KEPT SAFE: the function and the status-webhook routing are NOT deleted. The effective_failed branch still sends the non-financial 'canceled' _send_order_status_message; delivery/read/sent status handling, WhatsApp OTP, support auto-replies (PAY_MSG pulling/no_dues/error/etc.), and authorized order/receipt notifications are untouched. The three financial helper functions remain DEFINED (not deleted). PAYMENT_LOOKUP_REQUIRED is LEFT DEFINED with a comment explaining it is now dead on the financial path - no code path can create paid state from an unverified capture regardless of its value (verified by a test that sets it 'true').

RAZORPAY WEBHOOK UNCHANGED: no edit to payments/razorpay-webhook/handler.py or razorpay_verify; the authoritative verification boundary is not weakened.

TESTS: added tests/test_inbound_whatsapp_payment_superseded.py (6 cases) driving the REAL _process_payment_status against an in-memory recording DynamoDB fake (boto3 patched at import, no AWS/network, mirrors tests/test_inbound_whatsapp.py setup): a forged/unverified 'captured' event creates NO paid invoice (seeded invoice stays 'pending', no paid update_item) and does not call _mark_invoice_paid_by_reference / _generate_invoice_for_captured_payment / _check_and_notify_balance_due / a 'completed' order_status; a SUPERSEDED type-only audit record is emitted (asserts no contact/txn id/amount leak); retirement holds even with PAYMENT_LOOKUP_REQUIRED=true; a failed payment still sends the non-financial 'canceled' notice without settling; a non-payment 'delivered' status processes normally via _process_status. Verified the retirement-revert fails the suite: re-adding _mark_invoice_paid_by_reference to the CAPTURED branch fails 3 of the new tests; restoring passes all 6.

Updated tests/test_payment_reconciliation_safety.py::test_the_four_verification_outcomes_are_named_in_source: it now asserts the three outcome CONSTANTS plus the new 'in_whatsapp_payment_capture_superseded' audit event are named in source, and that the retired 'payment_capture_accepted_unverified' fail-open accept log is gone. (The other assertions in that file - payment_lookup_empty, PAYMENT_LOOKUP_REQUIRED default-off - still hold; the lookup logic is retained for audit.)

EVIDENCE: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q => 5734 passed, 1 skipped (baseline after FEAT-002 was 5727 passed, 1 skipped; +6 new tests, -0 regressions; one existing source-level test updated for the retirement). grep verification shows the two financial function names appear in the handler only as the preserved defs and the SUPERSEDED comment - no CAPTURED-branch calls. No frontend/TS files touched; no AWS or network calls (boto3 patched, lookup never addressed).
